aboutpara:
My name is Faiz and I recently graduated from the Computer Systems Technology Diploma program at BCIT, and I am now pursuing my Bachelor's degree. I'm on a mission to become a software developer so if you're looking for someone with a passion for code and a love of problem-solving, you've come to the right place. My portfolio website is where I showcase my skills, experiences, and projects. I'm all about creating innovative solutions and staying up-to-date with the latest tech trends.

Thank you for visiting!
